page.layout: Running head across top: one heading "Locorum Scripturæ." at full width. Below the columns at the foot: signature "Oooo 2" centred-left and catchword-like "Cap.XVI." at right, treated as signature/catchword furniture.

page.notes: Running head and catchword-like line "Cap.XVI." at foot right is the next-section marker; the left column's Roman numerals are chapter numbers.
